title: Is High Local Accuracy Enough? Geometric Consensus with Support-Adaptive Statistical Personalization for Federated Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.31133v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real-world deployment of personalized federated learning (PFL) requires adapting to heterogeneous clients while preserving recognition performance beyond local distributions. However, high local accuracy can conceal failures on locally rare or absent classes. Effective personalization should therefore strengthen global recognition while raising the personalization floor. We propose an evaluation protocol that complements local accuracy with global, rare-class, and unseen-class evaluations to reveal generalization obscured by local scores, and assesses personalization floors among the worst-performing clients to expose weaknesses hidden by aggregate performance. To meet these deployment challenges, we propose FedGRC, a unified PFL framework integrating generalization and personalization through (i) Consensus-Guided Representation Learning (CGRL), which learns discriminative representations through shared directional and magnitude guidance

translated_title: 高本地精度就够了吗？面向联邦学习的几何共识与支持自适应统计个性化
translated_abstract: 个性化联邦学习（PFL）的现实部署要求在适应异构客户端的同时，保持超越本地分布的识别性能。然而，较高的本地精度可能掩盖模型在本地稀有或缺失类别上的失败。因此，有效的个性化应在提升个性化下限的同时增强全局识别能力。我们提出了一种评估协议，在本地精度之外补充全局、稀有类别和未见类别的评估，以揭示被本地分数所掩盖的泛化能力，并在表现最差的客户端中评估个性化下限，以暴露被聚合性能隐藏的弱点。为应对这些部署挑战，我们提出了FedGRC，这是一个统一的PFL框架，通过以下方式整合泛化与个性化：(i) 共识引导表示学习（CGRL），通过共享的方向与幅度指导学习判别性表示
tldr: 提出FedGRC统一个性化联邦学习框架及配套评估协议，通过几何共识与支持自适应统计个性化，在提升最差客户端个性化下限的同时，增强模型对全局、稀有及未见类别的识别能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes FedGRC, a unified personalized federated learning framework with a complementary evaluation protocol, which strengthens global recognition of rare and unseen classes while raising the personalization floor among the worst-performing clients.
